title: Installment Rates by Combined Disability Compensation Rating (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Rate Table)
content:
The combined rating of a debtor's running **Disability Compensation** award sets a compensation rate on the monthly installment of a direct-payment repayment plan on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

| Combined rating of the running Disability Compensation award | Compensation rate |
|---|---|
| 70 percent or more | 110 percent (high-rating rate) |
| 30 to 60 percent | 105 percent (mid-rating rate) |
| 10 or 20 percent, or no running award | No compensation rate under this table |

The rate is a percentage by which the quotient of the balance to be spread and the months it is spread over is multiplied before the installment is rounded up to the cent; it acts on that quotient itself.

**Hypothetical cases.** A quotient of 200.00 USD for a veteran rated 80 percent: 200.00 multiplied by 110 percent, that is 220.00 USD. For a veteran rated 60 percent: 210.00 USD. For a veteran rated 20 percent: no rate under this table.
